title: Companion Product Recapture on Termination
content:
# Companion Product Recapture on Termination

Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda bundle terms for a waiver terminated after the lienholder reports the loan paid off or refinanced away. An amount is recaptured from the termination refund according to the status of the companion products sold on the waiver's own Vehicle Purchase Agreement:

| Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contract sold on that deal | Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plan sold on that deal | Recaptured from the termination refund |
|---|---|---|
| In active status | Any status, or none | 40.00 |
| Not active, or none | In active status | 20.00 |
| Not active, or none | Not active, or none | Nothing |

Products read: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts and Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans sold on the deal.

In words: where a Kessler Shield service contract sold on the waiver's purchase deal is in active status, 40.00 is recaptured; where no such contract is active and a Kessler Care maintenance plan sold on that deal is in active status, 20.00 is recaptured; in every other case nothing is recaptured.

The recapture is deducted from the refund after the unused-share amount has been rounded half up to the cent. The statuses read are those on the service contract's and the maintenance plan's own records; a product bought on its own, outside the purchase deal that carries the waiver, is not read.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A waiver whose deal also carried a Kessler Shield contract that has since expired and a Kessler Care plan that is fulfilled: neither is active, nothing is recaptured. Had the plan still been active, 20.00 would be recaptured.
